title: On the Road With Ukraine’s Refugees: An Update

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着300件你最珍贵的藏品去上班，你把一个DJ台变成了一个充满美丽、有50年历史的古董的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: This week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year and hearing what's happened in the time since they first ran.
sentences.zh: 本周，《每日新闻》将重新回顾我们今年最喜欢的一些单集，并听听自它们首次播出以来发生的事情。

sentences.en: we return to the beginning of Russia's invasion of Ukraine and the long and harrowing journey that many Ukrainians found themselves on as they fled their homeland for safety.
sentences.zh: 我们回到俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的初期，以及许多乌克兰人为寻求安全逃离家园而踏上的漫长而痛苦的旅程。
我们要离开酒店房间了。

sentences.en: And we're leaving the hotel room in Kyiv, walking through a very dark hallway to an elevator that will bring us down to the car where we will drive south and weSt.
sentences.zh: 我们正在离开基辅的酒店房间，穿过一条非常黑暗的走廊，走向一部电梯，它将带我们下楼去汽车那里，然后我们将向南和向西驱车行驶。

sentences.en: Last Tuesday, the New York Times made the decision to pull a group of reporters out of Kyiv and bring them to a city in western Ukraine that was safer, called Lviv.
sentences.zh: 上周二，《纽约时报》做出决定，将一组记者撤出基辅，带他们去乌克兰西部一个更安全、名为利沃夫的城市。

sentences.en: And just as we closed the trunk in the parking lot of the hotel, we heard this huge bang, and then another.
sentences.zh: 就在我们在酒店停车场关上后备箱时，我们听到了一声巨大的巨响，紧接着又是一声。

sentences.en: We just heard some artillery, unclear if it's incoming or outgoing.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚听到一些炮火，不清楚是打进来的还是打出去的。

sentences.en: We got into the car and drove out, and some ambulance is driving by.
sentences.zh: 我们上车驶离，一辆救护车从旁驶过。

sentences.en: Later, we would discover that those two booms were Russian military trying to blow up the television tower in downtown Kyiv.
sentences.zh: 后来我们发现，那两声巨响是俄罗斯军方试图炸毁基辅市中心的电视塔。

sentences.en: The truck, the traffic lights have stopped working.
sentences.zh: 卡车，交通信号灯已经停止工作了。

sentences.en: We're just driving through an intersection where there are some very serious-looking barricades.
sentences.zh: 我们正开车穿过一个路口，那里有一些看起来非常严肃的路障。

sentences.en: A bunch of sandbags and probably a couple of dozen men in black uniforms walking across the street, holding rifles.
sentences.zh: 一堆沙袋和大概几十名穿着黑色制服、手持步枪的人正走过街道。

sentences.en: After driving down those back roads out of Kyiv, under that really dark, low sky, we stayed in the town of Bila at Sirkva.
sentences.zh: 在沿着基辅郊外那些小路、在那片极其黑暗低沉的天空下行驶之后，我们在白采尔科维镇留宿了。

sentences.en: And we were woken up by another enormous boom.
sentences.zh: 我们被另一声巨大的巨响惊醒。

sentences.en: We kept driving that next day, and we thought we'd pretty easily be in Lviv by dinnertime.
sentences.zh: 第二天我们继续开车，本以为到晚饭前就能轻轻松松到达利沃夫。

sentences.en: But we just kept getting stuck.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直被堵在路上。

sentences.en: I mean, it was checkpoint after checkpoint, and this unbelievable crush of cars.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是一个又一个的检查站，还有数量惊人的拥挤车辆。

sentences.en: on Wednesday, and we're in a line of cars as far as the eye can see on the highway going west toward the Wolf from Wienica.
sentences.zh: 星期三，我们在一条一眼望不到头的公路上排着车队，向西开往文尼察方向。

sentences.en: Everybody has cars packed with kids, animals, suitcases.
sentences.zh: 每个人的车里都塞满了孩子、动物、手提箱。

sentences.en: A woman holding a little boy just waved at me.
sentences.zh: 一个抱着小男孩的女人正向我挥手。

sentences.en: Lots of cars with handmade signs in the window, taped to the windows, saying, children, Dikki.
sentences.zh: 许多车的车窗上贴着用胶带粘着的手写标语，上面写着“儿童”、“避让”。

sentences.en: It's just stretched on for miles and miles and miles, just going slowly, maybe five kilometers an hour.
sentences.zh: 车队绵延了数英里又数英里，缓慢前行，时速可能只有五公里。

sentences.en: And we're kind of neck and neck, so I'm going to stick my head out the window here and see if someone will talk to me.
sentences.zh: 我们的车差不多并排停着，所以我要把头探出窗外，看看有没有人愿意跟我聊聊。

sentences.en: Я из газеты New York Times, и меня зовут Сабрина.
sentences.zh: 我来自《纽约时报》，我叫萨布丽娜。
你们今天是打哪儿来的？
他从克罗皮夫尼茨基来。

sentences.en: We've been driving for six hours now.
sentences.zh: 我们已经开了六个小时的车了。
孩子们都坐在那儿，对吧？

sentences.en: His name is Валерий, and he has little kids in the back.
sentences.zh: 他叫瓦列里，后面坐着几个小孩子。

sentences.en: Как вы себя чувствуете сейчас, Валерий?
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样，瓦列里？

sentences.en: Потому что семья уедет, а я останусь.
sentences.zh: 因为家人要走，而我得留下。

sentences.en: I'm really feeling quite down, because my family is going out, and I'm going to need to stay.
sentences.zh: 我真的感觉很沮丧，因为我的家人要离开，而我需要留下来。

sentences.en: А что произошло в вашем городе, когда вы уехали?
sentences.zh: 你离开的时候，你们城市发生什么了？

sentences.en: Ну, я из Одессы, а был в Кировограде.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我来自敖德萨，之前在基洛夫格勒。

sentences.en: А в Одессе начали уже взрывы.
sentences.zh: 敖德萨已经开始有爆炸声了。

sentences.en: I was in Odessa before, and Odessa, there are already explosions starting in Odessa.
sentences.zh: 我以前在敖德萨，敖德萨已经开始发生爆炸了。

sentences.en: А какие чувства у вас есть сейчас в сердце?
sentences.zh: 你心里现在有什么感受？

sentences.en: He's saying, what are your feelings in your...
What are your feelings in your heart right now, right now?
sentences.zh: 你此时此刻心里的感受是什么？

sentences.en: And they said, very, very heavy, very pressed down.
sentences.zh: 他们说，非常非常沉重，压抑得很。

sentences.en: And his wife is starting to cry.
Я из газеты New York Times.

sentences.zh: 你们今天是打哪儿来的？

sentences.en: А сколько вы уже в этом трафике?
sentences.zh: 你们在这个车流里堵了多久了？
我们前天离开切尔尼戈夫的。

sentences.en: Oh, they left the day before yesterday.
Потому что он остался сидеть в погребе.
sentences.zh: 因为他一直坐在地窖里。

sentences.en: Мы были очень tired of sitting in the basement in a coffin.
sentences.zh: 我们厌倦了像在棺材里一样坐在地下室里。
我的房子下面正在打仗。

sentences.en: There, above my house, was a war going full force.
sentences.zh: 那里，我的房子上方，正进行着全面战争。

sentences.en: The old people are stuck in the houses.
Tell them to stop what's happening.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们停止正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: If you can tell somebody, just communicate this.
sentences.zh: 如果你能告诉什么人，请传达出去。

sentences.en: You have to stop this somehow.
sentences.zh: 你必须想办法阻止这一切。

sentences.en: They told us it was mined.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们那里布满了地雷。

sentences.en: Please, please tell them to stop it.
sentences.zh: 求求你，求求你告诉他们停手吧。

sentences.en: There were lots of moms consoling children.
sentences.zh: 有许多母亲在安慰孩子。

sentences.en: Sitting on their lap, sitting in the back, playing with toys.
sentences.zh: 坐在他们腿上，坐在后座上，玩着玩具。

sentences.en: One little baby had a stuffed mobile hung above her head, made of cloth mushrooMs.
sentences.zh: 一个小婴儿的头顶挂着一个用布做成的蘑菇婴儿床铃。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter from the New York Times.
Yeah, I'll give a second, of course.
sentences.zh: 行，我给一秒钟，当然可以。

sentences.en: Everybody talked about what it was that pushed them to actually go.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在谈论促使他们真正离开的原因。

sentences.en: There were so many explosions last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚有太多的爆炸声了。

sentences.en: And for the most part, it was explosions.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数时候都是爆炸。

sentences.en: So we're trying to get somewhere that is safe.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正试图去一个安全的地方。

sentences.en: Children feeling terrified, having to go down into basements all the time.
sentences.zh: 孩子们感到恐慌，不得不一直躲进地下室。

sentences.en: And parents just decided they'd had enough.
sentences.zh: 父母们只是觉得受够了。
我们终于到达检查站了。

sentences.en: Good morning, presser, presser, New York Times.
sentences.zh: 早上好，记者，记者，《纽约时报》的。

sentences.en: By the end of the day on Wednesday, it became pretty clear that we were never going to make it to Lviv that night.
sentences.zh: 到周三结束时，情况已经变得很明显，我们那天晚上绝对赶不到利沃夫了。

sentences.en: It was already getting dark, and we needed to stop for the night.
sentences.zh: 天已经黑了，我们需要停下来过夜。

sentences.en: And we were calling everywhere, any hotel, and everything was full.
sentences.zh: 我们到处打电话，找任何酒店，但都客满了。

sentences.en: And at some point, my colleague, Valerie, reached someone in a town called Vytovtsi, who said there was actually space at a kindergarten in their town.
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，我的同事瓦莱丽联系到了维托夫齐镇的一个人，他说他们镇上的一家幼儿园其实有空位。

sentences.en: And it didn't seem like a great option, but it was dark, and it was snowing.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不是个好选择，但天黑了，还在下雪。

sentences.en: And at that point, we didn't have a better idea.
sentences.zh: 当时我们也没有更好的主意了。

sentences.en: So we drove to the town, and we got out, and a man greeted us and introduced himself as the mayor of the town.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开车去了那个小镇，下了车，一个男人迎上来，自我介绍说是镇长。

sentences.en: And he said we just needed to bring our passports up to the second floor register, and then we could have the room in the kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 他说我们只需要把护照拿到二楼登记，然后就能住进幼儿园的房间了。

sentences.en: They took us into the kindergarten, and it was this...
sentences.zh: 他们把我们带进了幼儿园，这里是……

sentences.en: Oh, we're in a kindergarten, and there's a little...
sentences.zh: 哦，我们在一家幼儿园里，这里有一个小……

sentences.en: Really brightly painted series of rooMs.
sentences.zh: 颜色鲜艳的一系列房间。
小储物柜，儿童尺寸的座位。

sentences.en: There's painting of a giraffe and a palm tree on the wall, and a lot of spider plants.
sentences.zh: 墙上画着长颈鹿和棕榈树，还有很多吊兰。

sentences.en: And lots of little child-sized mattresses.
sentences.zh: 还有许多儿童尺寸的小床垫。
奥克萨娜带我们看厨房。

sentences.en: So we started to settle in for the night, and a very kind woman who ran the kindergarten made food for us.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始安顿下来过夜，幼儿园的一位好心妇人为我们做了饭。

sentences.en: She made us spicy rice with chicken.
sentences.zh: 她给我们做了辣味鸡肉饭。

sentences.en: And she had a huge jar of pickles that she had made herself, that she brought out, and we each took a pickle.
sentences.zh: 她还拿出一个她自己腌制的大罐泡菜，我们每人拿了一块。

sentences.en: We had dinner at a tiny little child-sized table, sitting on tiny little child-sized chairs.
sentences.zh: 我们在儿童用的小桌子旁吃晚饭，坐在儿童用的小椅子上。

sentences.en: Asking if this is the other family.
And pretty soon, another family showed up.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，另一家人出现了。

sentences.en: So Luda is grandmother, and then three grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 所以露达是祖母，然后是三个孙辈。

sentences.en: Doesn't she look so much older?
sentences.zh: 她看起来是不是成熟得多？

sentences.en: Oh, we were driving for 12 hours.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们开了12个小时的车。

sentences.en: They came from Cherkassi, a little bit below.
sentences.zh: 他们来自切尔卡瑟，再往下一点的地方。

sentences.en: Was it a attack or what was it like?
sentences.zh: 是遭到袭击还是怎么样的？

sentences.en: I'm saying what happened in Cherkassi, and they're saying explosions.
sentences.zh: 我说切尔卡瑟发生了什么，他们说是爆炸。

sentences.en: What was the push to leave?
sentences.zh: 促使你们离开的原因是什么？

sentences.en: How did you decide to leave?
sentences.zh: 你们是怎么决定离开的？

sentences.en: My family, who was living in Poland, and my mom was calling every day.
sentences.zh: 我的家人住在波兰，我妈妈每天都打电话来。

sentences.en: The truth is, I would actually like to stay.
sentences.zh: 说实话，其实我挺想留下的。

sentences.en: I think I would be helpful in some way.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我在某些方面能帮上忙。

sentences.en: But my mom, I mean, I want to be with her, really.
sentences.zh: 但我妈妈，我是说，我真的很想和她在一起。

sentences.en: I want to be with her.
And Ira, what are you feeling right now in your heart?
sentences.zh: 伊拉，你现在心里有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I was going in the car, and I almost started to cry because I understand that I'm just running from the war from my country, because it's a war.
sentences.zh: 我在车上时，差点哭出来，因为我明白我只是在为逃避国家的战争而奔逃，因为这是一场战争。

sentences.en: I was going in the car, and I was feeling like I was going to cry, because I felt like I was leaving my country, and it was actually war, and I was leaving my country.
sentences.zh: 我在车上时，感觉自己快要哭了，因为我觉得我要离开我的国家，这真的是战争，而我要离开我的国家。

sentences.en: It's a really horrible feeling, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一种非常可怕的感觉。

sentences.en: My dad is still in the town, and so is my boyfriend, and they're doing, and my boyfriend actually went to do the, man the checkpoints,
sentences.zh: 我爸爸还在城里，我男朋友也是，他们在干活，而且我男朋友实际上去负责把守检查站了，

sentences.en: and that can be a dangerous thing in town to man the checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 在城里把守检查站可能会很危险。

sentences.en: He stayed there, and he won't leave.
On one hand, I'm really proud.
On the other hand, I was trying to convince him not to do it, but then I thought, no, okay, go.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，我本想说服他不要去，但后来我想，算了，去吧。

sentences.en: Luda is offering us little pancakes with meat, and they're so good.
sentences.zh: 露达给我们提供带肉的小煎饼，它们太好吃了。

sentences.en: While we were there, standing in the kindergarten, talking, a woman walked in.
sentences.zh: 我们在幼儿园里站着聊天时，一个女人走了进来。

sentences.en: She owned a hotel right down the street, and she told us it was overflowing.
sentences.zh: 她在街那头开了一家旅馆，她告诉我们那里已经人满为患了。

sentences.en: People are, lots of people are sleeping, so we're going to try to not make a lot of sound.
sentences.zh: 人们，很多人在睡觉，所以我们要尽量保持安静。

sentences.en: She took us to her hotel, and when we went inside, we saw people lying everywhere.
sentences.zh: 她把我们带到她的旅馆，当我们走进去时，看到人们到处躺着。

sentences.en: There's a man who's sleeping in the corridor.
sentences.zh: 有个男人在走廊里睡觉。

sentences.en: This is another little place for sleeping, underneath a piano.
sentences.zh: 这是另一个睡觉的小地方，在钢琴底下。

sentences.en: So Armin is showing me where they're going to be sleeping.
sentences.zh: 阿尔明正在带我去看他们要睡的地方。

sentences.en: In a back room that was very small.
sentences.zh: 在一个非常小的后屋里。

sentences.en: Sometimes it feels like it just is an old movie that you're watching in front of your eyes.
sentences.zh: 有时候感觉这就像你在眼前看的一部老电影。

sentences.en: Armin is saying, come in, come in, welcome, or you're going to sleep under the table.
sentences.zh: 阿尔明说，进来，进来，欢迎，不然你们就要睡在桌子底下了。

sentences.en: It's two women and a young child who just came through the door.
sentences.zh: 是两个女人和一个刚进门的小孩。

sentences.en: And suddenly we heard these air raid sirens.
sentences.zh: 突然我们听到防空警报响了。

sentences.en: And everyone in the hotel moved toward a trap door in the floor and climbed down to the basement.
sentences.zh: 旅馆里的每个人都朝地上的活板门走去，爬到地下室。

sentences.en: Oh, it's scary, the little girl says.
They've suffered such days, my children.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们，他们度过了多么艰难的日子啊。
我们听到巨大的爆炸声。

sentences.en: We hear how people are suffering.
sentences.zh: 我们听到人们在承受怎样的痛苦。

sentences.en: When we left, I was trying not to cry in Kiev.
sentences.zh: 当我们离开时，我在基辅极力忍住不哭。

sentences.en: But when we left Kiev, I started just crying.
sentences.zh: 但当我们离开基辅时，我开始痛哭起来。

sentences.en: We really want the Ukrainian army to win, to succeed.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很希望乌克兰军队能赢，能取得胜利。

sentences.en: We see how it's so unjust what's happening.
sentences.zh: 我们看到发生的事情是多么不公正。

sentences.en: We want the Ukrainian army to win.
sentences.zh: 我们希望乌克兰军队赢。

sentences.en: So we're going back out of the shelter now, back out of the basement.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在要离开避难所，离开地下室了。

sentences.en: I guess the danger is over.
What time is it, you guys?
When we got the all clear after about half an hour, the families climbed back up the stairs, into their hallways and back rooms and next to the piano.
sentences.zh: 大约半小时后警报解除，各家人爬上楼梯，回到他们的走廊、后屋和钢琴旁。

sentences.en: And we went back to the kindergarten for the night.

sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括J.D.
万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: It's 12.30 on Thursday, and we're in a checkpoint line in western Ukraine that's stretched at least two hours, if not more.
sentences.zh: 现在是周四下午1点半，我们在乌克兰西部的检查站排队，队伍已经排了至少两个小时，甚至更久。

sentences.en: We've seen mothers taking little kids off onto the field on the right side of the road here to pee and go to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我们看到有母亲带着小孩子走到路右侧的草地上小便、上厕所。

sentences.en: One woman was pulling up her little boy's green underpants just a bit ago.
sentences.zh: 刚才还有个女人在帮她的小男孩往上提绿色内裤。

sentences.en: And we saw a woman helping an elderly woman, Babushka, down this sort of grassy area to get to the bottom so she could go to the bathroom, and she fell.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一个女人在帮一位老奶奶，也就是巴布什卡，走下这片草地想到底下去上厕所，结果她摔倒了。

sentences.en: And then she tried to help her, and she was helping her up.
sentences.zh: 然后她试图帮她，把她扶了起来。

sentences.en: Just an incredibly long line that's all of these people from all of these parts of Ukraine, from all over, are waiting in to get out.
sentences.zh: 这条队伍长得难以置信，所有这些来自乌克兰各地、四面八方的人都在排队撤离。

sentences.en: This is what happens when an entire country tries to evacuate in a week.
sentences.zh: 当整个国家试图在一周内撤离时，就会发生这种事。

sentences.en: We're at the very beginning of the checkpoint line that we've been in for two hours, and we're just pulling up.
sentences.zh: 我们刚开到排了两小时队的检查站队首，才刚驶过去。

sentences.en: Looks like a territorial defense guy checking our passports.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是个国土防御部队的人在查我们的护照。

sentences.en: He says, okay, go, go, drive.

sentences.en: We're driving up to the train station, and it is quite crowded.
sentences.zh: 我们正开车前往火车站，这里相当拥挤。

sentences.en: Streets, the sidewalks on either side of the street are just packed.
sentences.zh: 街道上，马路两侧的人行道全挤满了人。

sentences.en: And now we're going to get out and go with Alina, the volunteer, who's going to take us to the train station.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要下车，跟志愿者阿琳娜一起走，她会带我们去火车站。

sentences.en: When I got to Lviv, I went to the train station with a volunteer named Alina Avremenka.
sentences.zh: 当我到达利沃夫时，我和一位名叫阿琳娜·阿夫列缅科的志愿者一起去了火车站。

sentences.en: She's working to help refugee women and children, and she works with them mostly in the train station.
sentences.zh: 她致力于帮助难民妇女和儿童，主要在火车站为他们工作。

sentences.en: This is a packed, packed sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 这条人行道挤得水泄不通。

sentences.en: People are leaving the train station, flood, just a river of people leaving the train station.
sentences.zh: 人们正离开火车站，人潮汹涌，就像一条离开火车站的人河。

sentences.en: Oh my God, this is an unbelievably packed train station.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这个火车站挤得难以置信。

sentences.en: It's like a, it's like a, it's like a concert.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，这就像是，这就像是一场演唱会。

sentences.en: This is a queue for Poland.
It's really big, but now we are going for the waiting hall for mothers and their children.
sentences.zh: 队伍真的很长，但现在我们要去母亲和儿童候车室了。

sentences.en: When our volunteers are situated, and from where we are coordinated.
sentences.zh: 当我们的志愿者就位后，这也是我们的统筹指挥点。

sentences.en: I'm trying to get through, and we can't get through.
sentences.zh: 我想挤过去，但我们挤不过去。

哦，双肩包都贴到我脸上了。

sentences.en: Oh, there's a little boy carrying, holding a parakeet, a green parakeet in a clear plastic container that looks like it used to have cherry tomatoes in it.

sentences.en: People are, people are, people are, people are grabbing their bags, moving really suddenly and kind of with some urgency and desperation.
sentences.zh: 人们在，人们在，人们在，人们在抓起行李，极其突然地移动，带着某种急迫和绝望。

sentences.en: And while we were walking through the main terminal, now talking to the crowd, there was this surge forward in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 正当我们在主大厅穿行、和人群交谈时，人群突然向前涌去。

sentences.en: Everyone was moving toward this tunnel, a kind of underground passage that was packed so tightly.
sentences.zh: 所有人都涌向这条通道，一条挤得密不透风的地下过道。

sentences.en: This long line of people trying to get on the train to Poland.
sentences.zh: 这条长长的队伍正排队等着上开往波兰的火车。

sentences.en: Don't let things get out of hand.

sentences.zh: 我们从11点半就一直站着。

sentences.zh: 埃洛娜，你现在感觉怎么样？

sentences.zh: 我们很害怕，不知道我们要去哪里，我们的未来会怎样。

sentences.en: I was leaving yesterday with my daughter and I just was sobbing in the train.
sentences.zh: 昨天我和女儿离开时，在火车上一直泣不成声。

sentences.en: I left my whole family there, my husband, everybody, everybody is still there.
sentences.zh: 我把整个家庭都留在了那里，我的丈夫，每个人，所有人都还在那儿。

sentences.en: I didn't take anything with me, just my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我什么都没带，只带了女儿。

sentences.en: We were together, but we told each other, that everything is fine.

sentences.en: And I said, I don't know.
Do you feel yourself a refugee?

sentences.en: I didn't want to leave my husband.

sentences.en: In the 10 months since the war began, nearly 8 million Ukrainians have fled the country.
sentences.zh: 自战争爆发以来的10个月里，近800万乌克兰人逃离了该国。

sentences.en: The vast majority have been children and women under 40.
sentences.zh: 其中绝大多数是儿童和40岁以下的女性。

sentences.en: The exodus that started in the first weeks of the war was the fastest displacement of people since World War II.
sentences.zh: 战争头几周开始的大规模出逃是自二战以来最快的人口流离失所潮。

sentences.en: But by summer, as the Russian campaign stalled, Ukrainians began to reverse course, returning home to cities and towns where life had resumed.
sentences.zh: 但到了夏天，随着俄罗斯的攻势陷入停滞，乌克兰人开始逆转方向，返回生活已经恢复的城镇。

sentences.en: That changed again in the fall, when Russia began a series of relentless attacks on Ukraine's power infrastructure,
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，这种情况再次发生变化，当时俄罗斯开始对乌克兰的电力基础设施发动一系列无休止的袭击，

sentences.en: leaving broad swaths of the country without electricity, heat, or even water.
sentences.zh: 导致该国大片地区没有电力、暖气，甚至没有水。

sentences.en: Now, once again, more Ukrainians are leaving the country than coming into it.
sentences.zh: 现在，再次有更多的乌克兰人离开这个国家，而不是进来。

sentences.en: The overwhelming majority of Ukrainians have gone to the European Union.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数乌克兰人去了欧盟。

sentences.en: Poland has taken in the highest number at 1.5 million.
sentences.zh: 波兰接收的人数最多，达到150万。

sentences.en: Germany came in second, taking 1 million.
sentences.zh: 德国位居第二，接收了100万。

sentences.en: But as this hosting approaches the year mark, the strains of supporting such large numbers of people have begun to show.
sentences.zh: 但随着这种收容接近一周年，支持如此庞大人口的压力开始显现。

sentences.en: In Germany in recent months, three-quarters of states have reported that they've reached their limit with housing and education.
sentences.zh: 最近几个月在德国，四分之三的州报告称，他们在住房和教育方面已经达到了极限。

sentences.en: Austria has started to restrict free train travel it was originally providing to all Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 奥地利已经开始限制最初向所有乌克兰人提供的免费火车旅行。

sentences.en: And Poland has begun requiring that any Ukrainian staying in the country for more than four months has to pay part of their housing.
sentences.zh: 波兰也开始要求任何在境内停留超过四个月的乌克兰人支付部分住房费用。

sentences.en: The International Monetary Fund estimates that the cost to the European Union of supporting Ukrainian refugees could reach $39 billion in the first year of the war.
sentences.zh: 国际货币基金组织估计，在战争的第一年，欧盟支持乌克兰难民的成本可能达到390亿美元。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
